about.title: About Us
about.journey: My journey in the world of beauty started in the year 2000, passionate in make-up and wanting to be a make-up artist not knowing how enormous the variety in the beauty profession would be. During my apprenticeship I loved more and more everything about cosmetics and all the different treatments such as facials, epilation and nails which interested me most. Received my diploma 2004 in Luxembourg. 2016 I completed and received my Spa Manager diploma in Spain, expanding my knowledge in wellbeing, relaxation, skin biology-anatomy, aromatherapy and more...
about.passion: Passionate and love the moment when my client and I see the positive difference on their skin, nails or body, being able to consult them and feel the gratitude and appreciation is the BEST moment.
about.beauty: Beauty to me is natural, and to embrace every single expression wrinkle.

service1.name: Facial Treatment
service1.description: The pampering experience of our beautifying Phyt's facials can provide multiple health and beauty benefits. Our facials cleanses pores, exfoliates dead skin cells, hydrates and moisturises the skin. Our facials are ideal for maintaining good skin health and leave you with a radiant complexion. Every facial is tailored to your unique skin. We diagnose your skin on the spot and select the products and treatments that suit your needs best.

service2.name: Manicure
service2.description: Our manicure includes nail shaping, cuticle care, a relaxing hand massage, and optional nail polish in the color of your choice.

service3.name: Pedicure
service3.description: Our pedicure is a complete foot treatment for men and women, including nail care, cuticle work, exfoliation, hydration, massage, and optional nail polish—leaving your feet feeling light and refreshed.

service4.name: Eyelash Lift
service4.description: Long-lasting eyelash lift for a perfect look. Natural and elegant appearance.

service5.name: Spray Tan
service5.description: A quick, professional spray tan for a natural, radiant glow that lasts up to 14 days.

service6.name: Hair Removal
service6.description: We use gentle, high-quality strip wax to remove hair from the root for smooth skin and finer regrowth. Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin.

service7.name: Makeup
service7.description: Professional makeup for all occasions. From natural to glamorous looks.

service8.name: Spray Tan
service8.description: Natural sun-kissed look without harmful UV radiation. Perfect tan.

service9.name: Supreme Wellbeing
service9.description: Complete wellness therapy for body and mind relaxation. Aromatherapy and more.
